title: Answer: entities with intrinsic (proto)phenomenal natures standing in causal relations

statements.text: What is fundamental is a set of entities with intrinsic phenomenal or protophenomenal qualities standing in causal relations, the quiddities together with the structure physics describes. The forms differ on whether the quiddities are phenomenal, protophenomenal, physical or neutral, and Eddington called the base mind-stuff.

sources.quote: nature consists of entities with intrinsic (proto)phenomenal qualities standing in causal relations within a spacetime manifold
but we may think of its nature as not altogether foreign to the feelings in our consciousness
